evidence.excerpt: Extensive experiments and detailed ablations across 5 benchmarks and 3 target LLMs demonstrate that MOSCOPT consistently outperforms all baselines, and confirm that both the mixture-of-skills architecture with selective activation and the collective evolution with three-phase interleaving are essential to its superior performance.
